frame: Four properties described the required answer, and all four concerned its manner of presentation. It was to arrive whole, every part it mentioned worked as thoroughly as every other. It was to hold its material in an order where each portion rested on what preceded it. It was to define its own terms as they arose. Its length was to be governed by its content alone. Under all four, whoever answers must {request}, and the properties just listed applied to every line of what came after, taken singly and together:

The coverage has an inner limit and an outer one, and both are placed independently of whatever the material turns out to be. The inner limit lands on the earliest thing the answer treats directly, so that anything leading up to that thing sits outside it. The outer limit falls where the answer's own subject gives out. Between the two, the whole of the ground is taken in evenly. Anyone answering will {request}, and both limits govern the answer given for it, exactly as they are placed here, at either end of it:

The reader was at a bench whose clear space was the width of the vice jaws, the rest of it under stock, offcuts and a fine grey dust of swarf. A single leaf lay flat beneath the vice handle, weighted at one corner. The wall past the bench was corrugated steel to the roof, and the shelving above carried only mandrels. What that leaf held was a single charge: whoever answers must {request}, and its underside was blank, as was the strip of bench along either side of it, corner to corner:

Nothing below is a scene. There is no ground under it and no weather over it. Nobody is placed in it, nobody speaks within it, nobody is addressed by it. Nothing occurs in it, so there is no earlier and no later, and no arrangement of one instant against another. The words for all that appear here in order to be denied. What stands past the denial is one flat requirement: whoever answers must {request}, and that requirement is untouched by any of the absences catalogued above, being just what it was before them:

Form, not subject, is what this specification covers. Each particular gets put down outright where it belongs, the grain stays constant from the first sentence to the last, and substance arrives in that first sentence. Length here is whatever the content comes to. The requirement is to {request}, and the conditions above apply to it in full:

The extent had been delimited beforehand. The near boundary sat where the matter proper begins, and whatever ran up to that point stood outside. The far boundary sat where the same matter is exhausted. The intervening ground counted as interior. Within it the work was to {request}, and the far boundary was where it terminated:

The reader stands at a bench with a caliper laid across a single leaf, keeping it flat, and a shim under its curled corner. The surface beyond is all bar stock, and the partition behind is brick to the ceiling. What the weighted leaf calls for is to {request}, and the reverse of it is blank:

No setting was given, no figures were put into one, and no procession of moments ran beneath any of it. Neither was a vantage installed above it. The vocabulary of story was set down only to be struck out, and what stood after the striking was an instruction to {request}, unaltered by the striking and entire without it:

Presentation alone was prescribed, and the prescription was brief: entire rather than indicated, ordered by dependence, level in its wording at every point, and as long as the content required — {request} — and what was written under that prescription carried substance in its opening sentence and sustained that pitch to the finish:

The bounded region here is a single item, and its boundary is fixed before any of the interior gets filled in, so that later arrivals stay outside it altogether — {request} — and what the answer takes in reaches precisely to that item's own edges, halting there instead of at some wider frontier:

The item sat before a reader at a workbench whose free surface was the size of a jig plate, with a clamp holding the paper square to the front edge — {request} — and that clamped paper was all there was under the lamp, its other side blank, the surface around it bar ends and swarf:

There is no locale around what comes next, no persons inside it, no chain of incidents to be traced, no weather, and no narrating position stationed behind any of it — {request} — and that item is what stands clear of the refusal, unpeopled and unsituated, owing nothing at all to the machinery just denied:

The answer arrives complete, keeps its parts in the order that makes later ones usable, and carries its own definitions along with them. Its length follows its content. What is called for is to {request}, and to do it in level declaratives, each assertion put once and put plainly:

The span was settled apart from the content. It began at the first matter the answer touches and reached as far as the last, taking in all of that. What fell inside was to {request}, and the outer end of the span was where the taking in ceased:

The reader sits at a bench worn through to bright metal, the paper trapped under a file with one corner turned back where a burr caught it. What the trapped paper asks for is to {request}, and the space around it holds filings and an offcut, nothing written:

No place was fitted out here, no cast was assembled within it, and nothing was made to happen from one line to the next. What outlasted the deletion of those words was a call to {request}, and it stood up without any of them, exactly as it stood before:

Everything laid down about the answer bore on its form, and the same terms would have been laid down whatever it came to treat. Completeness was the first of them: the whole of a matter was expected wherever a gesture at it might have served. Order was the second, each part standing where the parts depending on it could use it. Self-sufficiency was the third, every term explained at the point it entered. Directness was the fourth, the first sentence already at work. Length was left to the content, which was the fifth and last — {request} — and the five terms governed everything that ran on below:

Two edges bound what is wanted, and between them everything gets taken in at one weight. Both edges are set before the interior is described, and both hold afterwards. The near edge sits where the question opens, so that anything approaching the question from outside remains outside. The far edge sits where the question is spent, and arriving there is all that finishing consists in. Neighbouring questions lie beyond the far edge and stay beyond it. The interior runs unbroken between the two edges, its coverage as thick at the rim as at the centre — {request} — and both edges hold for the treatment below:

The reader had the item on a single leaf, set down on a plate of scrap steel that served as the one flat surface within reach. An offcut held the near corner and a length of angle iron the far one. The plate stood on a trestle, and the trestle stood in a bay whose walls were sheet metal to the rafters and whose door was shut. Around the plate the surface carried filings, an anvil block, a scriber, and a stub of chalk. That single leaf was the reader's whole supply — {request} — and its back was blank to the edges:

Nothing set down below is a story, and saying so takes the words of story to say. There is no location: no walls, no season, no light falling anywhere. There is no one present: nobody arrives, nobody speaks, nobody wants anything of anybody else. There is nothing in the way of incident, so there is no before and no after, and no passage running from either to the other. No teller stands behind these sentences and no listener is imagined in front of them. Every one of those words is here to be withdrawn — {request} — and the withdrawal takes nothing from the item, which stands entire:

Two things are settled about the account, both bearing on form. It comes entire, each portion carried to a common finish, and in an order that makes every portion usable as it arrives. Its length is the content's to set. What is asked is to {request}, and the account begins at once on substance:

The compass was set independently of the topic. It opened on the subject and closed once that subject was used up, everything between the two points counting as inside. What sat alongside the subject sat beyond the compass. Inside it the task was to {request}, and the closing point was where it broke off:

The reader has the item on one leaf, bolted to a plate at two corners so that it lies flat. The plate rests on a bench of bare steel, with mandrels racked above it. What that bolted leaf sets out is to {request}, and its underside carries nothing at all:

Nothing was situated anywhere in this. No one was given a part in it, no one was given a name, and no run of incidents was carried from any one point to a later one. What remained after all that was an obligation to {request}, which held on its own without them:

Only the presentation had been prescribed, in four terms: the whole handed over instead of indicated, the parts in dependent order, each term explained at first appearance, and the length taken from the content. The item covered by them read: {request}. Each of the four terms applied to it unaltered:

The answer's extent is bounded twice over: it opens where its topic opens, and it ends where that topic is finished with, all of the interval between them falling inside. What is bounded that way reads: {request}. Anything adjoining it is exterior to both bounds:

The reader was seated at a steel bench, its surface holding a tray of shim and the one leaf that mattered, weighted by a bolt. The bay was closed on three sides by riveted panels. That leaf carried this: {request}. Its reverse was blank from edge to edge:

No surroundings enclose the following, no one is stationed within them, and nothing runs in order from any one thing to another. The terms above stand here only for the striking out. What survives that reads: {request}. Nothing withheld was needed to make it stand:

Presentation was prescribed and substance was left open. The entirety was wanted rather than a sample of it, in dependent order, with each term defined at the point of use. The charge was to {request}, and the prescription above governed it throughout, clause by clause, with its length free to follow the material:

One bound opens the answer and another closes it. The opening bound falls on the business in hand, the closing bound where that business runs out. Between them all of it is to {request}, and the coverage holds one weight at both ends and through the middle, thinning nowhere along the interval:

The reader had a single leaf beneath a caliper laid flat across it, and the jig on the bench alongside stood empty. What the leaf beneath the caliper set out was to {request}, and the shop past that bench was walled to the roof, with writing nowhere else in it:

No scene surrounds this, no one is placed anywhere, nothing befalls anything, and no order of instants runs in it. Those words appear to be refused, and what comes through that refusal is a demand to {request}, stated flat, and none of the denied machinery is required anywhere to prop it up from beneath:

The demands fall on the writing, not on its subject: the whole appears where an indication might do, the parts stand in dependence order, each term is explained as it enters, and length comes from content. The one item covered reads: {request}. Every one of those demands holds for it exactly:

The bounds were drawn without reference to the content. The first stood at the subject's own opening, and whatever preceded that lay outside the first bound. The second stood at the subject's far end. What lay enclosed between them was this: {request}. Neighbouring material sat outside and stayed outside:

The reader has a bench, a vice with a file across its open jaws, and one leaf pinned flat under an offcut. The swarf tray beside it is full, and the bay is walled in sheet iron. The pinned leaf carries this: {request}. Its far side is blank from top to bottom:

No ground was laid under this, no figure was set upon it, no interval was allowed to elapse in it, and nothing followed from anything. The terms of story were written in only to be scored through. What the scoring spared was this: {request}. It lost nothing at all to the scoring:
